subject: Fwd: Observability integration kickoff — Datadog / Grafana / OpenTelemetry
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@datadog.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Observability integration between Redwood & Datadog

Hi Marissa,

Love what you and the team are building at Redwood — Samir here from Datadog Partnerships. We have a growing set of customers asking for tight integration between LLM inference platforms and observability tooling (traces + logs + custom LLM metrics).

High-level idea: a small joint integration that does three things out of the gate — 1) export runtime traces (OTLP) from Redwood inference nodes, 2) surface model-level metrics (tokens/sec, cache hit rate, tail-latency percentiles) as custom metrics in Datadog, and 3) provide a starter dashboard + alerting template so customers can turn on SLO monitoring quickly.

I attached a short deck (dd-rw-integration-overview.pdf) with a proposed roadmap and a couple of API hooks we think will be easiest to instrument. Would you be open to a 30-min call next week to align on scope and owners? Prefer Tue/Wed morning PST.

Thanks — looking forward to coordinating.

— Samir Patel
Senior Partner Manager, Observability Integrations
Datadog
Attachment: dd-rw-integration-overview.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

Samir — thanks for the outreach and the deck. This aligns with feedback we've been hearing from our largest hosted customers. I'm copying Jonas (runtime engineering) and Ava (product) so we can scope the engineering touchpoints.

Proposed kickoff agenda (30 min):
- Quick goals + success metrics (5m)
- Tech hooks: OTLP exporter, model-level custom metrics, KV cache instrumentation (10m)
- Dashboards & out-of-the-box alerts (5m)
- Rollout plan (beta customers, Dedicated, Private) + owners (10m)

We're available Tue 17th or Wed 18th 9–11am PT. I'll also attach a draft playbook we use internally (rw-observability-playbook-draft.docx) to give context for the rollout and sample metrics.

Next step: if you can confirm 17/18, we'll send a calendar invite and include a short tech brief.

Best,

Marissa Cole
